verbs.name: find
verbs.label: Look something up in the Home Record
verbs.desc: What the Home Record holds on an appliance or device in the house: its model, when it was bought, its warranty or repair warranty, the last work done and the papers kept with it.
verbs.words: warranty warranties guarantee serial receipt receipts appliance appliances boiler furnace fridge dishwasher washer dryer oven serviced servicing
